title: bazel query rdeps fails in `//external` because `//:dummy` target doesn't exist

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Using `rdeps` against the `//external` package fails because Bazel tries to resolve the [android_sdk_for_testing](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/9a32b861799278217c37eb32f864a951ca99617e/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/bazel/rules/android/android.WORKSPACE#L16) `bind` rule to `//:dummy` using the local repository instead of [Bazel's root BUILD](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/9a32b861799278217c37eb32f864a951ca99617e/BUILD#L36).

```
# src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/bazel/rules/android/android.WORKSPACE
bind(
    name = "android_sdk_for_testing",
    actual = "//:dummy",
)
```

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

```
# WORKSPACE
workspace(name = "bazel_dummy_target")
```

```
bazel query 'rdeps(//external:*, //external:bazel_tools, 3)'
```

```
ERROR: /DEFAULT.WORKSPACE:25:1: no such target '//:dummy': target 'dummy' 
  not declared in package '' defined by <BAZEL>/BUILD.bazel 
  and referenced by '//external:android_sdk_for_testing'

ERROR: /DEFAULT.WORKSPACE:25:1: no such target '//:dummy': target 'dummy' 
  not declared in package '' defined by <BAZEL>/BUILD.bazel 
  and referenced by '//external:android_sdk_for_testing'
```
### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

MacOS

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

release 0.24.1


### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share?

A workaround is to add the dummy target in my local repo.  It seems like Bazel should use it's own dummy target.

```
filegroup(
    name = "dummy",
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```
